seo.title: sigerciv — Tourism Platform for Lampung
seo.description: Sigerciv connects village tourism across Lampung — discover cross-village destinations, support local MSMEs, and join Lestari missions.

hero.tagline: Travel that leaves a positive impact in Lampung
hero.imageAlt: Coastal tourism destination in Lampung — snorkeling in calm waters
hero.subtitle: Sigerciv stewards technology so destination data stays community-owned, economic value flows to local residents, and conservation funds can be monitored transparently.

featuredSpots.title: Featured spots
featuredSpots.subtitle: Active destinations from partner villages — community-curated and ready to explore.

valuePillars.title: Why sigerciv
valuePillars.subtitle: Three pillars of tourism: community data ownership, local value flows, and conservation transparency.

dataOwnership.title: Village-owned data
dataOwnership.body: Spot inventories, services, and media are curated by the community. The platform is only a steward — data remains with the village and Organization.

localValue.title: Value returns to residents
localValue.body: Transactions flow to MSME providers and local agents. A share of reinvestment is allocated to village conservation funds.

conservation.title: Transparent conservation funds
conservation.body: Committed to publishing verified conservation fund flows — no impact figures claimed before the data is ready.

misiLestari.title: Lestari Explorer & Lestari Passport
misiLestari.subtitle: Learn coastal tourism ethics, take verified actions, and collect stamps in your Lestari Passport. Full quests and Lestari Stations will follow in the next phase.

learn.title: Learn
learn.body: Understand coastal ethics, dolphin viewing codes, and sustainable practices before you visit.

act.title: Act
act.body: Join verified missions — from observation to contributing conservation data.

stamp.title: Passport stamps
stamp.body: Collect Lestari Passport stamps as a record of your Lestari journey.

pasarDesa.title: Certified MSMEs & local products
pasarDesa.subtitle: Tourism value flows to local providers. Certification tiers mark sustainable commitment from Tunas to Lumba-Lumba.

tunas.title: Tunas
tunas.body: First steps in sustainable practice — a baseline commitment to sustainable business.

bahari.title: Bahari
bahari.body: Measured coastal practice — marine tourism ethics and community contribution.

lumba.title: Lumba-Lumba
lumba.body: Highest tier — sustainable standards and transparent impact reporting.

jejakRegeneratif.title: Conservation impact transparency
jejakRegeneratif.subtitle: sigerciv is committed to showing verified conservation outcomes — from conservation funds to carrying-capacity indicators. Impact figures will only appear once verified monitoring data is available, not as aspirational claims.
jejakRegeneratif.commitmentBody: Conservation funds and the Lestari ledger will be published when the F3 data pipeline is active.
jejakRegeneratif.targetBody: Transparency will follow once conservation data is verified — no hard-coded figures on this page.

tentang.communityBody: {nama} is part of the sigerciv network — a village tourism platform where destination data and services are owned by the local community (Organizations & village officials), not a commercial aggregator. Every visit should ideally leave destinations better through carrying-capacity monitoring, reinvestment in conservation funds, and community participation.

pasar.deskripsi: MSMEs register tourism products and services independently. Transactions go directly to local providers — without a central aggregator commission.
fiturRencana: Ranking boost for Naik Kelas Lestari certified MSMEs

paket.deskripsi: Local agents compose itineraries, quotas, and tour package pricing with the Organization curation flow (draft → review → publish).

agen.deskripsi: Directory of tour package composers and certified guides in the village.

kontribusi.deskripsi: Residents and travelers contribute photos, tips, or destination data corrections. Content goes through a curation queue before going public.

lencana.deskripsi: Three-tier badges and community participation progress on the sigerciv platform.
fiturRencana: "Pioneer Citizen" badge for PWA early adopters

leaderboard.deskripsi: Rankings for data contributors and community participation per village.

peta.deskripsi: Interactive map of all public village spots. For now, use the map on the village showcase or multi-village discovery.

kalender.deskripsi: Seasonal event schedules — e.g. morning dolphins, festivals, or specific wind seasons. Managers can configure the calendar in the dashboard.

misi.deskripsi: Traveler quests: marine ethics micro-lessons, then verified actions (plant mangroves, beach cleanup, dolphin monitoring).

stasiun-lestari.deskripsi: QR check-in points at dolphin docks, mangroves, and conservation spots — proof of sustainable action attendance.

naik-kelas.deskripsi: Tiered MSME/agent owner certification: Tunas → Bahari → Lumba-Lumba through validated sustainable action cards.
fiturRencana: Tier & badge on Village Market listings

kartu-aksi.deskripsi: Concrete practices with proof: no single-use plastic, local ingredients, waste management, allocate % to conservation fund.

sertifikasi.deskripsi: Summary of Lestari certification tiers held by providers in the village.

dana-konservasi.deskripsi: Accumulation of reinvestment share from transactions and transparent usage reports for the community & village officials.

neraca-lestari.deskripsi: Combined eco-social-economic impact score — GMV-equivalent KPI for measurable tourism.

daya-dukung.deskripsi: Daily capacity per spot vs actual visits — over-capacity warnings for responsible ecotourism.

monitoring.deskripsi: Offline-first field forms: mangrove survival, coral health, collected waste — verified by residents & village officials.

paspor.deskripsi: Personal traveler impact passport — mission stamps, impact summary ("you helped plant 5 mangroves"), badges & digital certificates.
